fact: NIDP says Fayda is being requested to be delivered for all vital events (birth, marriage, death) at the Civil Registration and Vital Events Agency, with system integration discussions ongoing.

Addis Ababa Mayor Adanech Abiebie said the new city civil registration system facilitates data sharing among Immigration, Health, Courts, the National ID program and others, with no event or direction of exchange stated.
system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics with ID System
